profile.headline: Software Engineer at Tangram Flex
profile.summary: I graduated from the University of Cincinnati with a BS in Electrical Engineering and a minor in Embedded Systems. I'm very interested anything that deals with new technology and hope to develop new tools to allow people to experience life in a unique way.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3 Supervisor
positions.description:
Technical Lead for an embedded emulation program utilizing QEMU and PowerPC CPUs
Developed an Android Application focused on quick turnaround training and execution
Presented to customers the team's approach, challenges, and outcomes of each milestone within a project
Supervised multiple engineers, helping them address unique challenges and pushing their careers forward

positions.title: Firmware Engineer I
positions.description:
Coded unique solutions in Embedded C for ARM Cortex M processors.
Updated embedded systems for new products.
Created testing protocols to determine best practice for implementing features.
Generated product requirements based on design inputs, test protocols, and customer feedback.
Ensured firmware designs met medical device standards.
Developed communication solutions using CAN, UART, and I2C.
Debuged code using debuggers, logic analyzers and multimeters among various other test equipment.

positions.title: Co-Op
positions.description:
Researched and updated engine compressor models
Designed, Analyzed, and Visualized computational 
     fluid dynamic simulations (CFD) in FORTRAN

positions.title: Co-Op
positions.description:
Grid Management Engineer	
Designed, analyzed, and implemented plans to re-route electrical

Distribution Management Software, customer service coordinator
Distribution System Transformer Replacement Project, coordinator

positions.title: Electrical Design Engineer
positions.description:
Electrical Systems Drafter in Revit
